Nadia: noticed invoice-preview spike for multiple tenants after yesterday's deploy, lots of tokens attributed to "unknown_route".
Raj: checking ingest -> header normalization seems inconsistent; we have X-Route and X-Route-Id variants in logs.
Nadia: sounds like a precedence flip. can we add a route_origin tag and emit a header_variant metric ASAP?
Raj: yes. plan: 1) ingest emits route_origin (legacy/new/mixed/unknown) and provisional=true for unknown_route; 2) DashOps adds a preview card and alert for provisional > 0.5% daily tokens; 3) SRE can roll proxy toggle back if needed.
ingest-bot: alert: route-tagging-anomaly (1767771250) - 142 events missing route_resolution_id.
DashOps: will add the dashboard card and webhook to this channel.
Nadia: assign recon job to reclassify provisional credits within 24h TTL once mapping is fixed.
Raj: will open PR for route_origin and unit tests. ETA ~90m.
Nadia: cool. keep this thread updated with PR links and canary status.
